isolation: No production database/configuration read or written. No forward holdout rows copied.

crypto_derivatives_snapshots.query: SELECT "provider","instrument_name","observed_at","retrieved_at","payload_json" FROM "crypto_derivatives_snapshots" WHERE instrument_name LIKE 'BTC-%' AND julianday(observed_at)>=julianday(:warmup) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end) AND julianday(retrieved_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY provider,instrument_name,observed_at

crypto_funding_observations.query: SELECT "provider","instrument_name","observed_at","retrieved_at","payload_json" FROM "crypto_funding_observations" WHERE instrument_name LIKE 'BTC-%' AND julianday(observed_at)>=julianday(:warmup) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end) AND julianday(retrieved_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY provider,instrument_name,observed_at

crypto_spot_candles.query: SELECT "provider","product_id","interval_seconds","start_at","end_at","retrieved_at","payload_json" FROM "crypto_spot_candles" WHERE product_id='BTC-USD' AND interval_seconds IN (60,3600) AND julianday(end_at)>=julianday(:warmup) AND julianday(end_at)<julianday(:end) AND julianday(retrieved_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY provider,product_id,interval_seconds,start_at

crypto_volatility_observations.query: SELECT "provider","symbol","kind","window_seconds","source_start_at","observed_at","retrieved_at","payload_json" FROM "crypto_volatility_observations" WHERE symbol='BTC' AND julianday(observed_at)>=julianday(:warmup) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end) AND julianday(retrieved_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY provider,symbol,kind,window_seconds,observed_at

kalshi_candlesticks.query: SELECT "ticker","series_ticker","period_interval_minutes","end_period_ts","retrieved_at","payload_json" FROM "kalshi_candlesticks" WHERE ticker IN (SELECT DISTINCT ticker FROM kalshi_market_snapshots WHERE series_ticker='KXBTC' AND julianday(close_time)>=julianday(:start) AND julianday(close_time)<julianday(:end) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end)) AND end_period_ts>=:start_ts AND end_period_ts<:end_ts AND julianday(retrieved_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY ticker,period_interval_minutes,end_period_ts

kalshi_event_data_snapshots.query: SELECT "provider","event_ticker","data_type","observed_at","retrieved_at","is_historical","payload_json" FROM "kalshi_event_data_snapshots" WHERE event_ticker LIKE 'KXBTC-%' AND julianday(observed_at)>=julianday(:warmup) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end) AND julianday(retrieved_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY provider,event_ticker,observed_at

kalshi_event_fee_changes.query: SELECT "change_id","event_ticker","series_ticker","fee_type_override","fee_multiplier_override","scheduled_at","retrieved_at","payload_json" FROM "kalshi_event_fee_changes" WHERE series_ticker='KXBTC' AND julianday(retrieved_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY change_id

kalshi_market_snapshots.query: SELECT "ticker","observed_at","series_ticker","event_ticker","status","source_updated_at","close_time","result","payload_json" FROM "kalshi_market_snapshots" WHERE ticker IN (SELECT DISTINCT ticker FROM kalshi_market_snapshots WHERE series_ticker='KXBTC' AND julianday(close_time)>=julianday(:start) AND julianday(close_time)<julianday(:end) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end)) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY ticker,observed_at

kalshi_resolutions.query: SELECT "ticker","observed_at","result","settlement_value_dollars","settlement_ts","expiration_value" FROM "kalshi_resolutions" WHERE ticker IN (SELECT DISTINCT ticker FROM kalshi_market_snapshots WHERE series_ticker='KXBTC' AND julianday(close_time)>=julianday(:start) AND julianday(close_time)<julianday(:end) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end)) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end) AND (settlement_ts IS NULL OR julianday(settlement_ts)<julianday(:end)) ORDER BY ticker,observed_at

kalshi_rule_snapshots.query: SELECT "ticker","observed_at","rules_primary","rules_secondary" FROM "kalshi_rule_snapshots" WHERE ticker IN (SELECT DISTINCT ticker FROM kalshi_market_snapshots WHERE series_ticker='KXBTC' AND julianday(close_time)>=julianday(:start) AND julianday(close_time)<julianday(:end) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end)) AND julianday(observed_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY ticker,observed_at

kalshi_series_fee_changes.query: SELECT "change_id","series_ticker","fee_type","fee_multiplier","scheduled_at","retrieved_at","payload_json" FROM "kalshi_series_fee_changes" WHERE series_ticker='KXBTC' AND julianday(retrieved_at)<julianday(:end) ORDER BY change_id
